Popeyes distinguishes itself with a unique New Orleans style menu and its chichen is famous for its crunchy tastes with thin skin and juicy tender meat as well as the other signature food such as Cajun Wings, Chicken Tender, Popcorn Shrimp, etc.
pope.name: Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen

GoodPoint.name: Good Point Food
GoodPoint.text: Good Point Food Company Limited offers a diversified range of products, including swallow's nests, cordyceps, sea cucumbers and dried abalones and other dried seafood along with herbal tonics. Moreover, Good Point Food also produces its own brand of ready to eat products and healthy food such as braised abalone, food, soup, sweet soup and herbal jelly etc., together with various other Japanese, Korean, and international products available for customers.

pret.text: Founded in London in 1986, Pret is the short form of the British household name Pret A Manager ("Ready to Eat"). In 2002, the first outlet opened in Hong Kong and since then, Pret's mission has been simple, to serve freshly made food and good organic coffee, whilst also trying to do the right thing. Pret's sandwishes, salads and wraps are handmade fresh throughout the day using carefully sourced ingredients and offers unsold food to charity at the end of the day.
pret.name: PRET A MANGER

godivacafe.text: As the global leader in premium chocolate, GODIVA is dedicated to innovation and excellence in the Belgian tradition. From its famous truffles and shell-molded chocolate pieces to its chocolate biscuits, individually wrapped chocolates, gourmet coffees, hot cocoa, Chocolate Soft Serve and other indulgences, GODIVA is committed to bringing the ultimate chocolate experience to the world.
godivacafe.name: GODIVA Café

6W524A.addr: Food Court near Gate 40-80, Departures Level (L6)

master-hung.text: From Michelin-starred ‘Hung’s Delicacies’ founder & Chef Lai Wei Hung comes brand new premium Chinese quick-service dining concept ‘Master Hung’. The central ethos of ‘Master Hung’ focuses on using the highest-quality ingredients to deliver fair-priced, delicious Cantonese food in a relaxed setting. On the menu you will find a variety of carefully curated recipes, including ‘Satay Beef Tripe’, ‘Sweet & Sour Pork’, and of course, Chef Hung’s signature ‘BBQ Char Siu Pork’, famous for selling over 300 portions per day!
master-hung.name: Master Hung

lego.name: LEGO
lego.text: LEGO® Certified Store has returned to Hong Kong International Airport with a brand-new look. Offering a comprehensive range of LEGO products, the store invites fans to unleash their creativity and imagination. You are welcome to join the limitless creativity and imagination of this new store, guiding them onto new LEGO® adventures.

be-relax-spa-suites.name: BE RELAX SPA & SUITES
be-relax-spa-suites.text: Welcome to Be Relax Spa & Suites, the wellness sanctuary for travelers looking to relax before their flight. Enjoy a variety of wellness treatments including massages, nails and beauty or take some rest inside one of our private suites. Our services start at just 15 minutes. No appointment needed, just walk in and recharge before you fly!

valentino.name: Valentino
valentino.text: Malson Valentino was founded in 1960 in Rome by Valentino Garavani and Glammetti. As the most established Italian Maison de Couture, Valentino continues to inspire individuality by redefining the values of mastery and emotional beauty. Alessandro Michele was appointed as its Creative Director in April 2024.

yiu-fung.name: Yiu Fung Store
yiu-fung.text: Yiu Fung has been operating in Hong Kong for more than half a centry. Operating a variety of preserved fruit and specialty souvenirs. For decades, we have worked hard to maintain authentic Hong Kong flavors. Among them "winter ginger", "orange peel" and "Dried Plum" are the treasures of the town store. Today, Yiu Fung has become a time-honored brand in Hong Kong and a favorite souvenir shop for tourists.

wears-hk.name: Wear’s HK
wears-hk.text:
Take Hong Kong Fashion to the Skies! Experience the grand debut of "Wear’s HK" at Hong Kong International Airport! From September 1 to 14, 2026, this premier fashion pop-up will transform the airport into a global runway. Discover exclusive collections from four visionary Hong Kong designer brands as they showcase their creativity to the world.

“Wear’s HK” is organised by the Clothing Industry Training Authority (CITA) and sponsored by the Cultural and Creative Industries Development Agency of the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region as a flagship programme of the Hong Kong Fashion Fest.

rimowa.name: RIMOWA
rimowa.text: RIMOWA is a global leader in premium luggage. Since 1898, it has placed quality and innovation at its core, creating luggage for the discerning, purposeful traveler. Inspired by the aero planes of the pioneering era of aircraft construction, in 1937, RIMOWA introduced aluminum into the manufacture of its suitcases, revolutionizing the industry and creating their iconic design with parallel grooves. In 2000, they pioneered again, creating the first polycarbonate case on the market. Designed and engineered in Germany, RIMOWA combines heritage and craftsmanship with the rigours of modern technology. In 2017, RIMOWA joined LVMH Group.

tgcd.name: Design Gallery
tgcd.text: Design Gallery features more than 5,000 items crafted by 200 Hong Kong designers and brands. The offerings include premium gifts, electronics products, household appliances, toys, watches, jewellery, clothing and accessories.

rirakkusuya.name: RIRAKKUSUYA CLAW
rirakkusuya.text:
Rirakkusuya offers a premium, stress-relieving entertainment experience for your journey.

Featuring authentic claw machines, Gashapon, Photo Booths, and a curated selection of trending Pokémon TCG and collectible plushies, we provide a delightful escape for travelers to unwind. Beyond the excitement of the catch, Rirakkusuya is a sanctuary where you can rediscover life's "little joys" through the thrill of play. Whether you're a seasoned collector or seeking a moment of fun before your flight, join us to experience the ultimate sense of accomplishment and take home more than just a prize.

Shopping_packa_00080.addr: Near Gate 13-21, Departures Level (L5), T1 Satellite Concourse

KUO.name: KUO YUAN YE 1867 GRAND SELECTIONS
KUO.text: Originating in Taiwan in 1708, KUO YUAN YE was founded by Kuo Liang-Zhen in Shilin in 1867, inheriting traditional baking techniques and naming the bakery "YUAN YE." Renamed in 1945, it gained fame from a major order that established it as a key store. Over the past century, KUO YUAN YE has committed to handmade production, with classic egg yolk pastries selling 4.5 million pieces annually. 3) This blend of tradition and innovation reflects exceptional craftsmanship, making it a symbol of local flavor and an emotional connection for travelers.

balenciaga.name: Balenciaga
balenciaga.text: Founded by Spanish-born Cristóbal Balenciaga in 1917 and established in Paris in 1936. With Demna Gvasalia as Artistic Director since 2015, the House has continued to uphold the vision of Cristóbal Balenciaga by using an innovative approach to techniques and masterful cuts. Balenciaga offers women's and men's ready-to-wear, handbags, shoes, accessories, eyewear and a fragrance for women.

Shopping_child_00015.addr: End of Check-in Aisle F, Departures Level (L7)

popmart.name: POP MART
popmart.text: POP MART, founded in 2010, is an industry-leading pop culture and art toy company. Accumulating millions of fans around the world, POP MART has set foot in various countries and regions, and has established a platform of integrated operations covering the entire industry chain of designer toys. The POP MART business mainly focuses on global artist development, IP operation, consumer access, pop toy culture promotion, and investment in industry-related companies. The company has launched thousands of fan-favorites with popular IPs namely MOLLY, DIMOO, SKULLPANDA etc.

6MC055.addr: Near Gate 201-230, Departures Level (L6), Midfield Concourse

take-eat-easy.text: "Take Eat Easy" is designed with a theme inspired by neon-lit street markets, offering a vibrant Hong Kong-style retro ambiance. It serves high-quality multi-national cuisine, including Chinese, Western, Japanese, and Korean fast food, allowing customers to savor the rich flavors of Hong Kong nostalgia and diverse international tastes.
take-eat-easy.name: Take Eat Easy

bottega-veneta.name: Bottega Veneta
bottega-veneta.text: Bottega Veneta has set a new standard for luxury since its birth in Vicenza in 1966. Inspired by Italian culture with a global outlook, the house is defined by a distinctly refined attitude. Bottega Veneta uses noble materials to create considered pieces that become part of their owner’s lives. The house embraces a core philosophy of style, innovation and luxury, applied to a full offer for women, men and home.

laderach.name: Laderach
laderach.text:
Läderach crafts fresh, artisana Swiss chocolate that blends precision, passion, and world-class creativity in every bite.


Läderach is a renowned Swiss chocolatier celebrated for its commitment to quality, freshness, and artisanal excellence. Founded in 1962 by Rudolf Läderach, the brand has grown into a global icon of premium chocolate. Its signature product, FrischSchoggi—fresh chocolate bark—is handcrafted using the finest ingredients and Swiss milk. Läderach also offers an exquisite range of pralines, truffles, and seasonal creations, all made by expert chocolatiers, including world champions. With over 100 boutiques worldwide, the company delivers a luxurious chocolate experience that blends tradition with innovation. Every piece reflects Swiss precision, passion, and a dedication to delighting chocolate lovers everywhere.

CrystalElevator.name: Crystal Elevator
CrystalElevator.text:
Join us and discover a world of multimedia experience at Hong Kong International Airport!

At the Meeters and Greeters Hall, our travellers are welcomed by the Crystal Elevator which features unique digital contents that capture the multifaceted spirit of Hong Kong and the themes about travel, nature and fun. Each digital art piece offers a window into a unique universe, providing travellers with moments of pleasure, surprise, and wonder.

Visit ExperienceHKAirport.com for more details.

bee-cheng-hiang.name: Bee Cheng Hiang
bee-cheng-hiang.text: A Singapore epicurean brand established since 1933, Bee Cheng Hiang, is renowned for its barbeque meat snack series. With over 300 outlets in Asia, this food expert prided itself in providing customers with quality food items made from natural ingredients, with no additional MSG, preservatives or artificial colours.

dining_weste_00010.addr: Near Gate 214, Departures Level (L6), Midfield Concourse

nodi.text:
nodi means knot in Latin. Just like knots connecting lines and ropes, nodi is a metaphorical symbol for bringing people together through coffee, our space serving as a convergence point for our growing community tied together by shared values and dreams.

As a high-traffic pop-up shop at the airport, nodi believes that the store design should embody the unique characteristics of Hong Kong to leave a lasting impression on travelers. Therefore, the design inspiration for this project comes from the iconic newsstands found on the streets of Hong Kong.
nodi.name: nodi

opce.text: The sub-brand "Orchid Padaria Café Express" under the Orchid Padaria brand continues the philosophy of promoting classic cuisine through innovative thinking. Embracing the concept of a "Hong Kong-style food convenience store", it offers the most takeaway solutions for busy diners, while upholding the high standards characteristic of Hong Kong cuisine. The shop features a variety of essential local delicacies as highlights, ranging from Hong Kong-style bakery goodds to cha chaanteng food and street snacks, creating a one-stop destination for authentic Hong Kong food, drinks, and souvenirs.
opce.name: Orchid Padaria Café Express

nodi-moleskine.text: Coffee and retail shop providing handcrafted beverages, refined notebooks and stationary essentials
nodi-moleskine.name: nodi | Moleskine

asia-favourites.name: Asia Favourites
asia-favourites.text: Looking for authentic souvenirs before departure? Swing by Asia Favourites near gate 60, it is a specialty store that offers a wide variety of packaged foods that represent the taste of Hong Kong and Asia, including ready-to-eat packs, premium teas, local favourite snacks, and quality dried delicacies. Here, as if you are in the landmark “Western Market” in Sheung Wan, you will find something for everyone, extending the Hong Kong and Asian culinary experience with your loved ones back home.

iwc-schaffhausen.name: IWC Schaffhausen
iwc-schaffhausen.text: With a clear focus on technology and development, the Swiss watch manufacturer IWC Schaffhausen has been producing timepieces of lasting value since 1868. The company has gained an international reputation based on a passion for innovative solutions and technical ingenuity. One of the world’s leading brands in the luxury watch segment, IWC crafts masterpieces of Haute Horlogerie at their finest, combining supreme precision with exclusive design. As an ecologically and socially responsible company, IWC is committed to sustainable production, supports institutions around the globe in their work with children and young people, and maintains partnerships with organisations dedicated to environmental protection.

good-taste-gift.name: Good Taste Gift
good-taste-gift.text:
Good Taste Gift focused on providing Hong Kong specialty souvenirs, dedicated to promoting Hong Kong delicacies and culture. Its products include:

1. Local Specialties: Traditional snacks, candies, and biscuits that reflect the local flavor.
2. Artisan Crafts: Handmade crafts, panda arts that showcase local culture and art.
3. Souvenirs: Memorabilia suitable for travelers, reflecting local characteristics.

Good Taste Gift often emphasizes sustainability and social responsibility, supporting local products. Through these products, customers can not only enjoy unique flavors but also experience the charm of local culture.

5NC130B.addr: Near Gate 14, Departures Level (L5), T1 Satellite Concourse

wing.name: Wing Wah Cake Shop
wing.text: Founded in 1950, Wing Wah brings Hong Kong high quality traditional Chinese delicacies. Our freshly made mooncakes are on offer all year round. Wing Wah represents the essence of East Meets West, as well as the traditional Hong Kong food culture with our cakes and pastries, bridal cakes, preserved meat sausages, custard mooncakes, panda cookies and wife cake in different flavours. They are the perfect Hong Kong souvenir for travellers to bring them home. Wing Wah has won the trust from its local and international customers with the high quality food products.

peni.name: The Peninsula Boutique
peni.text: With a proud history in Hong Kong since 1928, The Peninsula has been synonymous with refined tastes and experiences, showcasing the skill and artistry of our talented culinary team. The Peninsula Boutique celebrates the finest gourmet ingredients that reflect the legendary hotel’s reputation for excellence. Our expert chefs and chocolatiers craft a range of gourmet products based on decades of unmatched culinary heritage. From exquisite artisanal chocolates to iconic signature mooncakes, our celebrated XO chilli sauces to exclusive tea blends and condiments.

long.name: Longchamp
long.text:
Longchamp handbags, luggage and accessories are renowned for their artisanship, French elegance and creativity, and 70 years of fine leather craftsmanship. Harmonising both the traditional and contemporary elegance of Longchamp, the collections exude a spirit of modernity and femininity.
The HKIA store of Longchamp is the first duty free outlet worldwide to offer personalisation service with hot stamping machine, premium product lines and exclusive items.

moncler.name: Moncler
moncler.text: Moncler was founded at Monestier-de-Clermont, Grenoble, France, in 1952 and is currently headquartered in Italy. Over the years the brand has combined style with constant technological research assisted by experts in activities linked to the world of the mountain. The Moncler outerwear collections marry the extreme demands of nature with those of city life. In 2003 Remo Ruffini took over the company, of which he is currently Chairman and CEO. Moncler manufactures and directly distributes the clothing and accessories collections under the brand Moncler through its boutiques and in exclusive international department stores and multi-brand outlets.

jardindejade.text: Jardin de Jade strives to revitalize authentic regional Chinese & Shanghainese flavor with novelties for its guests by offering a majestic dining environment and premium services. The menu features regional Chinese specialitieswith an emphasis on Shanghainese cuisine, appealing to both local and international tastes. Travelers with shorter dwell times will also feel welcome at Jardin de Jade, with snacks for casual dining and a modern bar serving fine wines, craft beers and signature cocktails. Jardin De Jade is now ready to deliver an exceptional dining experience for travelers in the Hong Kong International Airport.
jardindejade.name: Jardin de Jade

fook.name: Fook Ming Tong Tea Shop
fook.text:
Founded in 1987, Fook Ming Tong strives to modernize and promote the traditional tea culture with the direction of bringing Chinese tea to the international stage. It focuses on quality control, marketing, service quality and packaging design in its over 30-year operation.

Staff at Fook Ming Tong who speak fluent Cantonese, English and Japanese are equipped with profound tea knowledge, providing the highest quality service to customers. With its professional standing on the tea market, good quality is also guaranteed at Fook Ming Tong.

fan-town.name: FanTown
fan-town.text: Official Licensed World Cup National Team Store at Hong Kong International Airport. Shop authentic merchandise officially licensed from elite national teams including Argentina, Portugal, England and France. Discover official jerseys, fan cheering apparel, curated souvenirs, collectibles and figure toys – your ultimate stop for global football passion before departure.

adidas-sport-performance-store.name: adidas
adidas-sport-performance-store.text: adidas is a global designer, developer and marketer of athletic footwear, apparel and accessories with the mission to be the leading sports brand in the world. The store sells both Sport Performance gears from different sport categories and adidas Originals fashion items.

travelwell.name: travelwell
travelwell.text: travelwell is the first autonomous shop at HKIA. Located at the entrance of Sky Bridge, travelwell offers everything from packaged food, drinks, and souvenirs. Its advanced IoT technology tracks which products are selected and charges automatically. Customers can simply tap their credit cards at the entrance to enter, shop for their favourite items, and leave the shop without stopping for cashier checkout.

chin.text: Bank of China (Hong Kong) “Hong Kong International Airport Banking Services Centre” provides quality wealth management services, cross-border financial services, 24x7 round-the-clock agent-assisted video banking services as well as automated banking services (ATM, Foreign Currency ATM and Cash Deposit Machine) to both personal and corporate customers. (No Teller Counter Services)

star.text: The famous American coffee icon is now available at the airport in addition to their many outlets in Hong Kong. If you enjoy rich milky coffee, Starbucks is for you.
star.name: STARBUCKS

gelato-combo.text: GELATO COMBO was founded by two women who traveled to Italy to learn the art of gelato making firsthand. In addition to traditional Italian gelato, they also understand the impact of history and changing times on creativity, leading to the creation of unique flavors exclusive to GELATO COMBO that are unforgettable. We use all-natural high-quality ingredients, fresh materials, and infuse passion into our products. With 24 flavors to choose from, there is definitely one that will capture your heart!
gelato-combo.name: GELATO COMBO

ppf.name: POME by Pair Pair Full
ppf.text: Founded by Hong Kong designer brand Pair Pair Full, POME by Pair Pair Full brings brands from Poland and other Central European regions to Hong Kong like natural soaps, skin care, sustainable 14K gold jewellery, and our most iconic mismatching socks & apparel. POME (pronounced pǝ℧-mi) means Poland + Home, the brand aims to create a space full of joy and positive vibes.

7T100.addr: End of Check-in Aisle E, Departures Level (L7)

mann.name: mannings
mann.text: Mannings is Hong Kong's leading health and beauty chain with over 350 stores in the city. It offers a high quality, comprehensive range of health care, personal care, skin care and baby care products tailored to customers’ needs. Mannings is awarded Service Retailer of the Year in Mystery Shoppers Programme by the Hong Kong Retail Management Association for 6 consecutive years. Furthermore, for 13 consecutive years (2004 to 2016), Mannings has been voted by customers as the “No. 1 Most Preferred Brand” in the telephone survey conducted by Ipsos.

hang-heung.name: Hang Heung Cake Shop
hang-heung.text: Starting from 1920’s as a Chinese-style restaurant established at Yuen Long. Hang Heung now has a history. Nowadays, Hang Heung has become one of the most historic and traditional Chinese Cake Shops and also a well-known Chinese assorted pastries manufacturer in Hong Kong and in overseas Chinese communities.

7T086.addr: End of Check-in Aisle F, Departures Level (L7)

niko.name: NIKO-NIKO Lifestyle Store
niko.text:
Visit NIKO-NIKO for an immersive experience of happiness! We offer exclusive chiikawa, mofusand and other officially licensed products, along with a variety of unique items and limited-time offerings released regularly. Our dedication to spreading happiness and positive energy through our products helps create a joyful atmosphere.

At NIKO-NIKO, we strive to create a welcoming environment for everyone who visits, allowing you to feel the uplifting energy of our products. Our goal is to inspire heartfelt smiles and fulfill your desire for happiness in life!

men-wah-bing-teng.text: "Men Wah Bing Teng" brand is originated from a standalone "bing sutt" named Men Wah Bing Teng in Kowloon, Hong Kong with a long history dating back to 1970's. "Men Wah Bing Teng" serves Hong Kong traditional "bing sutt" with western-style fast food snacks. Signature dishes such as Men Wah BBQ Pork with Egg and Rice, Egg in Boiling Water and Sa Cha Beef Noodles, which we believe allows our customers to reminisce on such earlier years of Hong Kong.
men-wah-bing-teng.name: Men Wah Bing Teng

bacha.name: Bacha Coffee
bacha.text: Elegantly presented inside the shopping hub of Hong Kong International Airport, the legendary Bacha Coffee offers passengers an immersive journey into the art of traditional coffee preparation en route to their next destination. Select from over 200 varieties of 100% Arabica specialty coffees from 35 countries in loose beans available in bespoke grinds, packed in beautiful canisters or in signature single-serve coffee bags. Discover exquisite coffee accessories to give as gifts or bring home as treasured souvenirs. An unforgettable takeaway experience awaits, featuring a specialty coffee of choice served iced or hot, on an elegant tray with vanilla bean flecked Chantilly cream and raw sugar stick, along with freshly baked gourmet croissants and viennoiseries to sweeten your journey.

7TL008.addr: End of Check-in Aisle S, Departures Level (L7)

cccccc-select.name: CCCCCC Select
cccccc-select.text: CCCCCC Select is dedicated to discovering local brands to infuse everyday life with local culture and creative charm. Our curated products combine practicality with minimalist aesthetics, balancing art and daily functionality to offer distinctive fashion accessories and lifestyle goods. Whether you’re searching for unique souvenirs or thoughtfully crafted gifts, CCCCCC Select is your ultimate destination to explore Hong Kong’s creativity.

8T011.addr: Near Check-in Aisle F, Departures Level (L8)

lime-garden.text: LIME GARDEN (SKY)+ offers authentic Thai and Vietnamese cuisine as well as contemporary cocktails and alcoholic beverages. Come and try LIME GARDEN (SKY)+’s signature dishes including beef noodle in soup, cold vermicelli with charcoal grilled pork chop and Thai style curry crab.
lime-garden.name: Lime Garden (Sky)+

teawg.name: Tea WG Boutique
teawg.text: Tea WG introduces a treasure trove of exotic teas and accessories at Hong Kong International Airport, to bring the thrill of discovery to your teacup. The boutique provides the perfect solution for travellers in search of sophisticated gifts. Enjoy Tea WG collection of fine teas from various tea-producing country with colourful packaged tea tins and tea accessories to accompany exquisitely handcrafted tea-infused macarons, available in a choice of luxurious gift boxes.

7T090.addr: End of Check-in Aisle F, Departures Level (L7)

canteen.text: can.teen adopts a simple and stylish design, offering a casual resting space for diners at the airport. In the design of the menu, the team of can.teen chefs have devoted all their efforts. In addition to Chinese and Western food, Japanese and Southeast Asian cuisines are offered from time to time, allowing diners to enjoy the tastes of different countries.
canteen.name: can.teen

hohk.text:
Ho Hung Kee was founded in 1946. For more than 60 years Ho Hung Kee have maintained the traditional culinary skills that have won us numerous accolades, including a Gold Award at the Hong Kong Tourism Board’s “Best of the Best Culinary Awards”.
Since 2008, we have been listed in the world-renowned Michelin Guide (Hong Kong and Macau edition), recommended by its panel of international reviewers and in 2010, we were awarded “one-star” recognition.
hohk.name: Ho Hung Kee

arabica.text:
% ARABICA, is an international specialty coffee chain brand from Kyoto, Japan. We bring this brand to Hong Kong with Top espresso machine, top roaster, top coffee, top experience since 2017.

Since 2014, Arabica has a global footprint more than in 23 countries. We always maintain the original heart and humble attitude towards coffee

Our dream is to have Arabica all over the world, so that our baristas and customers can see the world through coffee with us.

The "%" symbol, at first glance that looks like coffee beans growing on the branches of a tree, and it has become the signboard of today.
arabica.name: %Arabica

god.name: Goods of Desire (G.O.D)
god.text:
Hong Kong's original lifestyle brand G.O.D. is a representation of Hong Kong's culture and design. G.O.D.'s designs are inspired by the vibrant culture of Hong Kong, with award-winning products range from home furnishings to fashion to premium gifts. The brand turns everyday subjects into truly extraordinary objects with humour and creativity.

G.O.D.'s motto is 'Proudly Hong Kong' – the pride to be born in Hong Kong and to promote the city's culture to the world.

burberry.name: BURBERRY
burberry.text: Burberry is synonymous with quality, innovation, style and dishevelled elegance, where beautiful craftsmanship is contrasted with form and function, always with a relaxed and distinctive British attitude. All collections and accessories are naturally influenced by over 150 years of providing practical and modern all weather garments. Located at Hong Kong International Airport Terminal 1, Burberry offers a range of outerwear, ready-to-wear and accessories for mens and womens collections.

traveling-muzeum.name: TRAVELING MUZEUM
traveling-muzeum.text: This is a sanctuary of art IP-themed boutiques, bringing together the creations of domestic and international artists as well as Intangible cultural heritage art masters. Each product is a unique artistic creation, blending traditional craftsmanship with contemporary design. Every piece radiates creative soul, seamlessly integrating art into daily life and transforming it into collectible everyday elegance.

saint-laurent.name: Saint Laurent
saint-laurent.text:
Founded in 1961, Yves Saint Laurent was the first couture house to introduce, in 1966, the concept of luxury prêt-à-porter with a collection called "Saint Laurent Rive Gauche", synonymous with youth and freedom. This shift represented a first critical step in the modernization of fashion and revolutionized the socio-cultural landscape.

Throughout the years, the House's groundbreaking styles have become iconic cultural and artistic references, and its founder, the couturier Yves Saint Laurent, secured a reputation as one of the twentieth century's foremost designers.

Part of the Kering Group, the House kept true to its identity of absolute modernity and fashion authority. Under the creative direction of Anthony Vaccarello, appointed in April 2016, the House offers today a broad range of women’s and men’s ready-to-wear products, leather goods, shoes, jewellery and eyewear. Through a license agreement, it is also a major force in fragrances and cosmetics.

6E174.name: MCM
6E174.text: MCM is a luxury lifestyle goods and fashion house founded in 1976 with an attitude defined by cultural Zeitgeist and its German heritage with a focus on functional innovation, including the use of cutting-edge techniques.

dining_fastf_00035.addr: Food Court near Gate 40-80, Departures Level (L6)

gourmet.text: Gourmet Focus Group is a platform allowing regular brand rotations, especially for famed Hong Kong brands. The store emphasizes the importance of being a destination for quality food at Hong Kong International Airport. The brand rotation will invite partnering brands that are hidden gems/ neighbourhood favourites, Michelin-recommended concepts, renowned chefs from Hong Kong and beyond.
gourmet.name: Gourmet Focus Group

Waterfall-Garden-South.name: Waterfall Garden (South)
Waterfall-Garden-South.text:
Join us and discover a world of multimedia experience at Hong Kong International Airport!

Waterfall Gardens invite travellers to enjoy a moment of repose with the soothing sights and sounds of nature. Rewarding patience and stillness with wondrous and surprising revelations from the creek and pond, this interactive multimedia ecosystem promises moments of relaxation and delight day and night. Visitors are encouraged to take in the garden’s lush plant life, listen closely to the pond’s rippling water, observe birds as they fly overhead, and immerse themselves in the energy of an ever-flowing waterfall.

bvlgari.name: BVLGARI
bvlgari.text: Based in Rome, since 1884 Bulgari has been creating renowned fine jewellery. Today it is a global and diversified luxury brand with a product and services portfolio of jewels, watches, accessories, fragrances, hotels and resorts featuring exceptional quality, an innovative style and impeccable service.

NUTTEA.text: Since 2017, NUTTEA has been developing nut-related diets and continuously improving the quality of nuts. The featured five nuts are baked and cold-pressed into our signature Nut Mylk, which is not only beneficial to human health but also creates a rich flavor, making it a better choice to mix with tea, coffee or fresh fruits.
NUTTEA.name: NUTTEA

vivi.name: Vivienne Westwood
vivi.text: Established in 1971, Vivienne Westwood is one of the last independent global fashion companies in the world. With a design record spanning over fifty years, Vivienne Westwood is now recognised as a global brand and Westwood herself is remembered as one of the most influential fashion designers in the world. The Vivienne Westwood collections feature a selection of traditional British fabrics, incorporating avant-garde tailoring into the brand's signature silhouettes, exuding a timeless charm that is sensual and elegant.

Since Qeelin's founding in 2004, every piece of jewellery has carried rich cultural connotation, reinterpreting traditional symbols with stylish designs intended for daily wear, infusing new life and contemporary meaning to Chinese heritage.

Named after the Qilin, an auspicious Chinese mythical animal and icon of love, Qeelin fuses unbridled creativity with excellence in craftsmanship. It brings a touch of playfulness and surprise into the world of fine jewellery.

Wulu is Qeelin's most iconic collection, a stylish expression of good fortune and positive energy, a magical balance of lines and curves.

flying.name: FLYING HONG KONG
flying.text: Flying Hong Kong presents a wide variety of souvenirs that embody Hong Kong's popular cultural icons. Developed from a palette of images from Hong Kong taxi, the sailing junk boat to the dynamic night skyline, the souvenirs are definitely a not-to-be-missed item to complete your unforgettable trip in Hong Kong.

koi-kei-bakery.name: Koi Kei Bakery
koi-kei-bakery.text: The use of wood and concrete creates a natural and rustic ambiance. The overall goal is to create a warm, harmonious, and comfortable environment where customers can leisurely browse for souvenirs for friends and family. Thoughtful design elements such as spacious aisles and rounded wooden display counters embody Koi kei Bakery's core philosophy of "customer first.

cartier.name: Cartier
cartier.text:
About Cartier

A reference in the world of luxury, Cartier, whose name is synonymous with open-mindedness and curiosity, stands out with its creations and reveals beauty wherever it may lie. Jewellery, high jewellery, watchmaking and fragrances, leather goods and accessories: Cartier's creations symbolize the convergence between exceptional craftsmanship and a timeless signature.
Today, Cartier is part of the Richemont Group and has a worldwide presence through its network of flagships and boutiques, authorized retail partners, and online.

urban-coffee-roaster.text:
We are an award-winning local specialty coffee brand. Since 2014, we have been passionate about exploring coffee origins around the world, meticulously selecting premium green beans and freshly roasting them in our roastery every week. This ensures that each batch of coffee beans delivers the best flavor and aroma.

In 2024, our co-founder Gary Au achieved remarkable success by winning both the "Hong Kong Coffee in Good Spirits Championship" and the "Hong Kong Barista Championship". In 2025, he proudly secured 6th place in the "World Coffee in Good Spirits Championship."

At our airport outlet, you can savor a diverse range of specialty coffees, freshly baked pastries, award-winning coffee cocktails crafted by Gary Au, protein shakes tailored for fitness lovers, and our exclusive airport coffee butter. All these delightful treats are available for dine-in or takeout!

Feel free to visit us next to Gate 40 at Hong Kong International Airport or at various locations throughout Hong Kong. We look forward to seeing you!
urban-coffee-roaster.name: Urban Coffee Roaster

lin-heung-lau.name: Lin Heung Lau

lululemon.text:
Established in Vancouver, Canada in 1998, lululemon is a technical athletic apparel company inspired by yoga. We make product for both men and women for all their sweaty pursuits.

The manifesto print on our shoppers is a collection of lines that are thought-provoking, inspirational and reflect our values. It's a visual representation of our beliefs, it's what we stand for. What do you believe?

A Fresh Take on Hong Kong Bing Sutt Culture!

A New Delight for Your Taste Buds!

Mike Café is a contemporary Hong Kong - style café brand built around a distinctive milk-forward concept, reimagining the beloved bing sutt culture through a modern lens. Rooted in local heritage, we blend nostalgic flavours with today's lifestyle to create a refreshed yet familiar dining experience.

Mike Café is more than a café - it is a taste of Hong Kong's collective memory. We aim to offer every traveler a comforting and authentic Hong Kong experience during their journey.
milk-cafe.name: Milk Cafe

metapod.name: METAPOD
metapod.text:
METAPOD has arrived at Hong Kong International Airport.  The store design offers a comfortable, fresh, well lighted, live product demo display with touch and feel shopping experience.  
 
METAPOD offers a large range of international well-known brands and the best selection of Digital, Audio, Home Tech and Small Home appliances at competitive prices.
 
Sprint-Cass, which has been running travel retail stores in Changi Airport in Singapore for the past two decades, specialises in electronics and tech lifestyles products.  METAPOD is a new and exciting destination especially designed to match the sophisticated travellers at HKIA.

yutakke.name: YuTakKe
yutakke.text: Welcome to YuTakKe, your essential destination at Hong Kong International Airport for authentic Hong Kong flavors and Asian delicacies. Since 2017, we've curated the finest traditional snacks—from preserved fruits and premium dried plums to handmade egg rolls, sweetheart cakes, and artisanal cookies. Discover Malaysia’s top durian products and Singapore’s fragrant bak kwa. Our unique multi-brand collection brings together the most beloved treats, perfect for immediate enjoyment or as memorable gifts. Let YuTakKe be your final, authentic taste of Hong Kong—a delicious conclusion to your journey and the perfect start to sweet memories.

Featuring 40 - 50 creators at any time, our collections reimagine Hong Kong landmarks, street-foods, heritage, and traditions in unique designs. Beyond T-shirts, we also curate lifestyle accessories, Hong Kong IP toys, art pieces, and publications - offering more ways to enjoy and bring home Hong Kong creativity

Flavors from Hong Kong and Macau, made from natural ingredients

Creatively diverse, yet staying true to the original vision

The Shanghee Company was established in Hong Kong in 2010. The company has manufacturing facilities in both Hong Kong and Macau. The brand upholds the inheritance of traditional craftsmanship while incorporating research and development of innovative concepts, producing delicious baked goods such as palmier, mille-feuille almond stick, cookies, egg rolls, duck egg rolls, and portuguese almond cookies.  Shanghee has food R&D centers in both Hong Kong and Macau. Recharge.text:
Departing passengers can enjoy a brand-new boarding experience at Terminal 1!

Our boarding gates feature vibrant themed zones that transform waiting and boarding into a delightful experience with entertainment, family friendliness and relaxation.

The Recharge Zone lets travellers unwind in a relaxing environment with cosy reclining chairs and a lush, green natural ambience.

brunello-cucinelli.name: Brunello Cucinelli
brunello-cucinelli.text: Founded in 1978 and based in the medieval hamlet of Solomeo, Brunello Cucinelli is the expression of an exclusive proposal of ready-to-wear and a sophisticated concept of contemporary lifestyle. Craftsmanship, artisanship, and "Made in Italy" represent the pillars of the collection's offering, a unique combination of beauty and Italian style.

ryu.text: “Ryu” blends traditional Japanese aesthetics with modern minimalism to create a dining space that is both comfortable and refined. The restaurant offers individual hotpot, delicate rice bowls, udon, and breakfast options to satisfy different times of day and tastes. We believe that even in an airport, food should be an enjoyment and a cultural experience. We hope “Ryu” will become a new landmark in Hong Kong International Airport, where every guest can, through a bowl of warm soup, feel the warmth and charm of culture.
ryu.name: RYU竜

asia-selections.name: Asia Selections
asia-selections.text: Asia Selections builds on our Grand Selection and Asia Delight brands, clearly signaling a curated range of top Asian products for HKIA customers. The Chinese name DOR YO LEI (多友礼) combines abundance, friendship, and gifts, reflecting thoughtful gifting and strong relationships. Easy to pronounce in Cantonese and Mandarin, it instantly resonates as a gift brand, reinforcing its appeal.

boutique-by-the-grand.name: BOUTIQUE BY THE GRAND
boutique-by-the-grand.text: BOUTIQUE BY THE GRAND is a sub-brand of THE GRAND HK that celebrates the fusion of international flavors with the essence of Hong Kong’s food culture. With a spirit of craftsmanship and a commitment to local production, we offer artisanal pastries, baked goods, and gift sets. Whether you’re looking for refined treats for your journey or a heartfelt present for someone special, BOUTIQUE BY THE GRAND provide thoughtful selections for every occasion, creating memorable experiences that combine quality, flavour, and a touch of Hong Kong artistry.

hubiz.name: HUBIZ
hubiz.text: HUBIZ offers a curated selection of high-quality, innovative, and practical travel products that make every journey seamless, comfortable, and enjoyable. Whether you’re a business traveler, a family on vacation, or a first-time flyer, HUBIZ is here to ensure you’re fully equipped for the adventure ahead.

dining_asian_00018.addr: Food Court after Departures (North), Departures Level (L7)

moon-thai.text: Renowned for its authentic Thai flavors, Moon Thai established its presence in the Sheung Wan Soho district in 2012, followed by the grand opening of Erawan Thai Premium in Tsim Sha Tsui in 2015. Moon Thai Express launched at the Hong Kong International Airport passenger terminal in 2018, and the first "FoodHall by Moon Thai" is set to open in Kwun Tong in 2023. All branches uphold the culinary traditions and service philosophy of the original establishment, maintaining meticulous attention to detail across every aspect—from the selection of ingredients and cooking processes to the hospitality extended to guests. Our Thai chef team with experience accumulated in Thailand, China and Hong Kong has been working with local team to adhere to strict screening and exploring of the best food and ingredients for constantly cooking innovative and delicious dishes. Their dishes have not only earned many awards, but also gained a recommendation in the Michelin Guide for consecutively five years.
moon-thai.name: Moon Thai Express

Waterfall-Garden-North.name: Waterfall Garden (North)
Waterfall-Garden-North.text:
Join us and discover a world of multimedia experience at Hong Kong International Airport!

Waterfall Gardens invite travellers to enjoy a moment of repose with the soothing sights and sounds of nature. Rewarding patience and stillness with wondrous and surprising revelations from the creek and pond, this interactive multimedia ecosystem promises moments of relaxation and delight day and night. Visitors are encouraged to take in the garden’s lush plant life, listen closely to the pond’s rippling water, observe birds as they fly overhead, and immerse themselves in the energy of an ever-flowing waterfall.

Wonder.name: Themed Zone: Wonder
Wonder.text:
Departing passengers can enjoy a brand-new boarding experience at Terminal 1!

Our boarding gates feature vibrant themed zones that transform waiting and boarding into a delightful experience with entertainment, family friendliness and relaxation.

The Wonder Zone allows passengers to immerse themselves in movies, virtual reality experiences and games.

heinemann.name: Sweet Dreams by Heinemann
heinemann.text: Sweet Dreams is a happy, fun, colourful whimsical world filled with optimism, wonder, hope and limitless imagination. Providing a gleeful surprise for the spirited child and a sweet distraction for adults, Sweet Dreams evokes your curiosity every time you visit us. Shop at Sweet Dreams for your favourite chocolate, candies and confectionery now!

kiton.name: Kiton
kiton.text: Kiton embodies the excellence of Italian high tailoring. Founded by Ciro Paone in Naples in 1968, the company celebrates the absolute primacy of quality, expressed in the motto “the best of the best +1”. A love of and passion for dressing well is combined with the desire to made hand-crafted creations in which Neapolitan sartorial traditions are interpreted with an innovative eye.

king-bakery.text: King Bakery provides freshly baked egg tarts every day. The brand is the only of its kind with its egg tarts being certified as a Hong Kong Q-Mark Product. King Bakery also provide a variety of breads, pastries and local snacks, allowing passengers to have a taste of authentic Hong Kong food before boarding.
king-bakery.name: KING BAKERY

bamboo-garden.name: Bamboo Garden
bamboo-garden.text: Mr. Wong Hon Keung, the founder of Bamboo Garden, is committed to preserving the traditional craftsmanship of Dragon Beard Candy. It is about nurturing and passing down a refined craft that embodies our intangible heritage.

ray-ban.name: Ray-Ban
ray-ban.text: Timeless style, authenticity and freedom of expression are the core values of Ray-Ban, a leader in sun and prescription eyewear for generations.

kanine.name: Kanine
kanine.text:
Welcome to Kanine, the best place for “Paw” rents to find top international brands and official premium products for our beloved four legged friends. We ship globally to spread the love, joy and happiness like never before.

We are the official global licensee for dog products for brands such as BOSS, Tommy Hilfiger, florence by mills and Warner Brother, and many more to come.

saicho.name: Saicho Sparkling Tea
saicho.text: Founded in 2020, Saicho is redefining how people celebrate. The British-Hong Kong brand creates the world's finest sparkling tea—unmatched in taste, beauty, and elegance. Saicho is for those who celebrate with intention, seeking complexity, sophistication, and connection without compromise. With offices in the UK, Hong Kong and Dubai, Saicho continues to expand globally while maintaining its commitment to quality, craftsmanship, and cultural heritage.

kolpop.name: KOLPOP
kolpop.text: Kolpop is a lifestyle and trend boutique located inside Hong Kong International Airport specialising in toys and memorabilia. emmer-pizza-bar-cafe.text:
Emmer Pizza, Bar & Cafe is serving up Hong Kong’s only pizza made using the natural heritage, organic grain, emmer. This modern, perfectly crunchy, yet deliciously chewy pizza, marries ancient ingredients with modern techniques, using only the finest added ingredients to deliver a naturally better and naturally tastier pizza experience

Crafted for the discerning traveller, this sweeping venue offers an all-day ticket to seriously special pizza, pastries and much more. Unwind with an extensive cocktail collection, in a tranquil sanctuary, savouring premier airport views. It’s the perfect start to your journey.

Its healthy traditional steam cooking method retains the full flavour of fresh locally-made food with finest ingredients. Tong Kee’s signature dishes include Steamed Rice with Spare Ribs & Chicken Feet, Glutinous Rice with Chicken, Roasted Pork & Salted Egg Yolk Wrap, Quail’s Egg Dumplings and Pork & Cabbage Bun. Quality is Tong Kee Bao Dim’s priority. It provides speedy service and quality food in reasonable price to customers.

saffron.text:
Saffron Persian Cuisine: A Culinary First in Hong Kong

As the first-ever Persian restaurant in Hong Kong, Saffron Persian Cuisine brings authentic flavors and traditions to the city. Fully Halal-certified and using 100% Halal meats, the restaurant ensures the highest quality and authenticity.  

With premium ingredients like saffron, the world’s most expensive spice, Saffron delivers luxurious flavors in every dish. Signature offerings include the Lamb Koobideh and Chicken Koobideh, tender and flavorful kebabs crafted to perfection.  

Experience the finest in Persian cuisine at Saffron Persian Cuisine.

Tasty prides itself on its family recipes passed down for generations, which took traditional Chinese/Cantonese congee and noodles to a new level. It has won numerous accolades including multiple "Best of the Best Culinary Awards" from the Hong Kong Tourism Board and being named a "Bib Gourmand Restaurants" (restaurants offering a good quality menu for a modest price) by the Michelin Guide.

Loro Piana boasts six generations of experience in the production of high-end textiles and continues to be an industry leader. This vertical integration is the best guarantee to access research, the best raw materials and the control of the manufacturing processes, which together with the ability to meld trailblazing technology with the Italian artisanal and sartorial tradition, make Loro Piana a brand of reference in the luxury goods market.

We have fashion for adults, kids, pets as well as gifting, stationary and accessories for all members of the family. panerai.name: Panerai
panerai.text: Founded in Florence in 1860 as a workshop, shop and school of watch-making for many decades Panerai supplied the Italian Navy specialist diving corps with precision instruments. Originally created to be used deep underwater, Panerai watches are known for their unparalleled legibility and luminosity in the dark. In 1997 the brand was acquired by the Richemont Group and launched on the international market. Today Panerai develops and crafts its movements and watches at its Neuchâtel manufacture, combining Italian design flair and history with Swiss horological expertise.

piaget.name: Piaget
piaget.text:
The unique allure of Piaget lies in the audacity of its style. Charismatic and flamboyant, dazzling watch and jewelry creations embody the radiance that defines the Maison.

Building on over 140 years of history, the ever-bold Maison continues to innovate by offering jewels in motion, elegant and extravagant High Jewelry collections, as well as remarkable watches. Piaget the watchmaker-jeweler continues to explore unexpected creative possibilities, turning gold, stones and gems into brilliant works of art.

the-forest-bakery.text: Devoted to crafting bread and cakes with all care, bringing Hong Kong’s traditional bakery culture back to life. By blending timeless recipes with creative twists, we give classic flavors a fresh identity that resonates with younger generations. Each loaf and slice carries the warmth of tradition while embracing innovation, inviting more people to discover and savor the unique charm of Hong Kong–style bread and cakes. This is not only about taste—it is about preserving heritage and passing on a beloved local flavor to the future.
the-forest-bakery.name: The Forest Bakery

5T115.text:
Australians Scottie Callaghan and James Wilson opened the first FINEPRINT in 2016. Since then, they’ve built a business focused on quality: exceptional coffee, delicious food, and great hospitality.

FINEPRINT coffee is sourced from farmers around the world and roasted weekly in Chai Wan. Our menu features simple dishes made from the best ingredients, including freshly baked sourdough sandwiches, toasts and toasties, as well as light ricotta bowls, nourishing salads, and bakery treats – available to enjoy in-store or on the go.

You can find FINEPRINT at the Arrivals Hall of HKIA and at a variety of locations across Hong Kong.
5T115.name: FINEPRINT

crys.text:
Entered Hong Kong in 2001, a Singapore-based culinary brand with multiple MICHELIN BIB GOURMAND awards (Hong Kong) for seven consecutive years, well-regarded for its modern twists on authentic Shanghainese cuisine and provincial favorites.

We emphasize the ingredients selection with care, as well culinary expertise, and commitment to quality. We serve authentic flavors with heart, from the signature Xiao Long Bao to irresistible handmade La Mian. By offering the warmth of comfort, togetherness, and familiarity, we nourish the body and soul.
crys.name: Crystal Jade La Mian Xiao Long Bao

tory-burch.name: Tory Burch
tory-burch.text: Tory Burch is an American lifestyle brand that embodies the personal style and sensibility of its Chairman, CEO and Designer, Tory Burch. Launched in February 2004, the collection includes ready-to-wear, shoes, handbags, accessories, watches, home and fragrance. There are more than 200 Tory Burch boutiques across North America, Europe, the Middle East, Latin America and Asia, and the brand is available at over 3,000 department and specialty stores worldwide.

homeless.name: HOMELESS MINI MARKET
homeless.text: This HOMELESS MINI MARKET concept store at HKIA featuring a curated selection of toys, lifestyle, personal and travel accessories for design-loving travellers.

HKairportDevelopment.name: Hong Kong Airport Development Exhibition
HKairportDevelopment.text: Step into the "Hong Kong Airport Development" exhibition to immerse in a century of aviation heritage. Follow Kai Tak's legacy, HKIA milestones, Terminal 2 commissioning triumphs, and the airport's sustainability vision. Interactive elements delight families and travellers of all generations.

tumi.name: Tumi
tumi.text: Since 1975, TUMI has been creating world-class business and travel essentials, designed to upgrade, simplify, and beautify all aspects of life on the move. Blending flawless functionality with a spirit of ingenuity, TUMI is committed to empowering journeys as a lifelong partner to travellers in pursuit of their passions. The brand is available globally in over 75 countries with more than 2,200 points of sale.

chaumet.name: Chaumet
chaumet.text: CHAUMET was established in 1780 by Marie - Etienne Nitot. He was appointed to design jewellery for Napoleon and all members of the royal family after his creations for Napoleon's coronation and wedding. Today, Chaumet from Place Vendôme Paris inherits the expertise of the Paris jeweller by carrying over the firm's core values for modern day princesses. Chaumet's creations keep coming in a mix of fashion, elegance, style and unique creativity.

chi-cha-san-chen.text: Selecting essence from tea branches, the flavor you tasted is our insistence. CHICHA San Chen achieves the concept of "International Beverage". Serving the best drink is our faith for now and forever.
chi-cha-san-chen.name: Chi Cha San Chen

the-alchemist-cafe.text:
The Alchemist Cafe was established in October 2012 as the first travel-themed coffee shop in Hong Kong. In addition to offering dining services, it regularly hosts activities related to travel, art, culture, and social welfare.

Over twelve years, the Alchemist Cafe has moved into cultural hubs and local communities. It aspires to continue fostering cultural connections, feeding not only the body but also nurturing the soul, while promoting cherished values and universal awareness.
the-alchemist-cafe.name: THE ALCHEMIST CAFE

apm-monaco.name: APM MONACO
apm-monaco.text: Influenced by Monaco and the South of France, APM Monaco is a contemporary fashion jewellery brand with a touch of Monegasque flair. Named after founder Ariane Prette, APM Monaco was created in 1982 and made her mark first in producing pieces for many great names in the jewellery business. After 30 years of developing and perfecting traditional handcrafted quality jewellery, the Prette family decided to venture into the design-focused jewellery business and continues to carry on Ariane’s legacy with the aim to make APM Monaco not only a household name but one that is modern yet timeless and fits perfectly with current market trends.

chagee.text:
Established in 2017, CHAGEE now has over 6,275 stores worldwide as of February 2025. As a representative of modern Oriental tea, CHAGEE upholds the mission of "Connecting the World with Oriental Tea," exploring millennia-old tea cultures globally to create CHAGEE's new tea lifestyle.

We decided to take on the mission of resuscitating and reintroducing this tea culture to the world with a modern twist and offer freshly brewed tea with a focus on being "refreshing, low-calorie, and healthier with controlled sugar," providing tea lovers with a better tea experience.
chagee.name: Chagee

gucc.name: GUCCI
gucc.text: Gucci is one of the most prestigious brands in the world offering fashionable men and women leathergoods, eyewear and accessories.
